title: H-STEAMNET-2 - the per-connection Steam rate controller is present and IDLE on the rig: the DEV lever 'steamrate' reports rateControl=on (settings key SteamRateControl absent = on) and links=0 before hosting and while hosting with a direct-IP client (the IP link is LiteNetLib, not a Steam connection), and the global Steam config is still 256K/256K/512 KB. The controller's real behaviour (1 s samples, rises/back-offs, per-connection min = max, read-back, logging) is UNIT-TESTED with synthetic links (tools/unit-tests/steamrate-tests.ps1) and REVIEW-VERIFIED until a real two-account Steam session. NO save, no world load.
preconditions: Dev build with SteamRateController (BAMP_DEV levers 'steamrate' and 'steamnet'). Steam valid on BOTH instances. UDP 7777 FREE.

steps.note: PREMISE: the settings key is absent on the rig, so the controller is on; no Steam link exists yet
hosting with an IP client: the controller stays idle - no Steam connection, no samples, no rate lines

steps.expect_result: ^OK steamnet config:\ ICE=-1\ sendRate=262144\-262144\ sendBuffer=524288\ applied=True\ at='startup'\ links=0$
steps.note: the GLOBAL config is unchanged by H-STEAMNET-2 (256K/256K/512 KB)
